A white-gloved hand at the upper right and another at the left edge retract or support the skin; a blood-stained white gauze pad is held at the left edge, with red staining on its surface. In the centre, a small red granular raised lesion sits on the perianal skin to the image-left of the dark anal opening. Folds of skin and part of the perineum and buttocks are visible; an ungloved hand is partly visible at the lower-right edge, and a white cloth or drape lies along the bottom edge. No panel letters, arrows, scale bar, ruler, text, labels or burned-in identifiers are visible. No face is visible.
